useCase: Annotated galleries and image-led collections: art/photo study vaults, exhibit notes, media logs and reference boards where images sit beside their commentary.
distinctFeatures: Images and embeds render as matted, framed exhibits with a soft shadow

Blockquotes styled as wall-label annotation cards
Catalogue links use gold cross-references with underline cues
